description: This file defines a convention class 'GroupByApiRootConvention' implementing 'IControllerModelConvention' to automatically assign group names to controllers based on the API version extracted from their route attributes in an ASP.NET Core project.

classes.name: GroupByApiRootConvention
classes.description: Implements IControllerModelConvention to group controllers by their API version based on route attributes.

methods.name: Apply
methods.description: Applies the convention to a controller model, extracting the API version from its RouteAttribute and assigning it to the API explorer's group name.
